It is supplied under the Indus Hydraulics brand in 9 sizes, hose bore -06 to -16. See all [spiral hose crimp fittings](/c/spiral-hose-crimp-fittings).

faqs.q: How do I read the part number on the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose, such as IH-CF71-ORBM-0606?
faqs.a: In an IH-CF71-ORBM number the last four digits give the hose bore dash size first, then the end size code. On the SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting, IH-CF71-ORBM-0606 is a -06 (3/8") hose with a 9/16"-18 end, and IH-CF71-ORBM-1616 is a -16 (1") hose with a 1-5/16"-12 end. The size table lists every number with its hose and port.

faqs.q: Which Parker fitting does the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose replace?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting replaces the Parker 10571 series. The size table pairs each Indus number with its Parker number, for example IH-CF71-ORBM-0606 for Parker 10571-6-6 and IH-CF71-ORBM-1616 for Parker 10571-16-16. Send a Parker number from your bill of materials and we will cross it.

faqs.q: What hose sizes does the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose cover?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting comes in 9 sizes covering hose bore -06 to -16: -06 (3/8"), -08 (1/2"), -10 (5/8"), -12 (3/4") and -16 (1"). Choose by the hose bore first, then by the end size.

faqs.q: Which end sizes are available on the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose?
faqs.a: The end sizes on the SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting run from 9/16"-18 to 1-5/16"-12, for example 9/16"-18, 7/8"-14, 1-1/16"-12 and 1-5/16"-12. One hose bore can carry more than one end size, so quote both the hose bore and the thread you are connecting to.

faqs.q: What working pressure can the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose hold?
faqs.a: The hose grade and bore set the pressure rating of an assembly made with the SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose; give us the hose grade and bore and the working pressure you need, and we will confirm it in writing.

faqs.q: What is the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose made from, and is stainless steel available?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting is carbon steel with a zinc-plated, cr3+ passivated, rohs-compliant finish, and 316 stainless is available on request for marine, offshore and washdown service. Tell us the service environment if you want the stainless option quoted.

faqs.q: Which standards does the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose follow?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting is listed to SAE J514, SAE J1926-1, with a O-ring boss (ORB) face seal. Match it to a port of the same standard, because a mismatched seat can look similar and still leak.

faqs.q: Which ferrule do I need with the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting needs the matching Indus crimp ferrule for the hose grade; the ferrule, not the fitting, is what changes between hose constructions. Choose from the [crimp ferrules](/c/crimp-ferrules) range, or send the hose grade and bore and we will specify the ferrule and crimp diameter.

faqs.q: Can Indus make up a finished hose assembly with the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose?
faqs.a: Send the hose grade and bore, the overall length and both end fittings, and Indus will crimp and pressure-test the assembly with the SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting before dispatch. This listing is the spiral-hose series; for braided hose use the [braided hose crimp fittings](/c/braided-hose-crimp-fittings), or read [braided vs spiral hose fittings](/blog/braided-vs-spiral-hose-fittings) if unsure.

faqs.q: How does the SAE O-Ring Boss Male Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose differ from the NPT Male Rigid Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose?
faqs.a: The SAE O-Ring Boss Male spiral-hose fitting and the [NPT Male Rigid Crimp Fitting for Spiral Hose](/p/npt-male-rigid-crimp-fitting-spiral-hose) are two versions of the same crimp fitting family. They differ as follows: thread UN/UNF straight thread here against NPTF tapered pipe thread; seat O-ring boss (ORB) face seal here against Dryseal tapered pipe thread, metal-to-metal; the NPT Male Rigid also reaches larger hose bores. Choose by the port on your equipment and the hose bore, then confirm both against the size table.
